entries.zh: 姿——姿色、美貌（女子姿态容貌之美）
entries.en: beauty; good looks and graceful bearing (of a woman)

entries.zh: 娣——古时姊妹同嫁一夫之妹（夫家众妇中居幼者，即媵妾）；亦指弟妇（娣妇）
entries.en: junior wife among the co-wives of one husband (younger sister wed along with her elder sister); also younger brother's wife, sister-in-law
entries.notes: H/M 两栏均带 [疑]（娣/婦、teg/tè），西语词头所指（夫众妇之一）为推断

entries.zh: 嫦——月中仙子嫦娥之单字
entries.en: Chang'e; the woman (goddess) dwelling in the moon

entries.zh: 嫦娥——月宫仙女、月中女神（相传奔月者）
entries.en: Chang'e, the moon goddess (the woman who is in the moon)

entries.zh: 婶——婶母（父亲的幼弟之妻）；闽语中弟妇亦有（小）婶之称
entries.en: aunt (wife of father's younger brother); (Hokkien also) younger brother's wife
entries.notes: 西语缩写 her~o demi 8e. 中 8e 未详，叔母/弟妇之别依 H/M 两栏推断

entries.zh: 亲婶——亲婶婶（嫡亲的叔母）
entries.en: one's own aunt (proper, blood-relation aunt)
entries.notes: 同第5条：缩写 8e 未详，依 H/M 两栏定释义

entries.zh: 伯姆——伯母（父亲的兄长之妻）；旧时妯娌间亦称兄妻为伯姆
entries.en: aunt (wife of father's elder brother); elder brother's wife in sisters-in-law's address
entries.notes: 缩写 8o 未详（与第5/6条之 8e 相别，疑示伯/叔长幼），依 H/M 定为伯母

entries.zh: 姐仔——姐儿、小姐（对年轻女子的昵称，兼有姊姊之称）
entries.en: little sister; familiar address for a young woman / miss
entries.notes: 西语词头 capada 罕见（疑为 casada 之讹写），释义主要依 H/M 两栏

entries.zh: 媳妇——新妇；新娘、儿媳（闽语中兼指出嫁入门之妇）
entries.en: bride; daughter-in-law; a married woman received into the family

entries.zh: 出嫁——（女子）出嫁、嫁人；（父母）嫁女
entries.en: to marry (of a woman); to be wed, given in marriage
entries.notes: 首字声调符号污损（T99）按规程降为低置信；出嫁字义本身由汉字与音写互证尚清

entries.zh: 尼——尼姑，出家收修之女（西语 recogida 即收闭静修之女）
entries.en: nun (Buddhist); a woman enclosed/secluded in religious retirement
entries.notes: M 栏混入西语 recogida ultima 且带 [疑:ultima/otravía]；取尼＝收修之女为定

entries.zh: 尼姑——出家女众、庵堂中的女僧
entries.en: Buddhist nun

entries.zh: 女将——女将、女中豪杰（女子有将才之称）
entries.en: a woman of general-like mettle; heroic, capable woman
entries.notes: 西语词头 ques caga 无法与已知 17 世纪义项对应（疑有讹损），仅据 H/M 两栏定形释义

entries.zh: 表子——婊子、娼妓（表子为明清俗写，后作婊子）
entries.en: whore; prostitute; harlot

entries.zh: 下贱——卑贱、下流（出身或品行低贱）
entries.en: base; lowly; vile (of low birth or conduct)

entries.zh: 破色——破身、失贞（女子已非完璧）
entries.en: deflowered; corrupted — a woman who has lost her chastity/virginity

entries.zh: 杂杂——行止混杂、不贞专（谓女子私通者众）
entries.en: promiscuous; 'mixed-mixed' — a woman with many (love) friends
entries.notes: H 带 [疑:雜雜/軟軟]；取杂杂（混杂不专）更合西语 'tiene muchos amigos'

entries.zh: 私情外意——私情、外心（已婚女子怀外遇之情）
entries.en: illicit love; extramarital affection (secret feelings, outside intent)

entries.zh: 节操——贞节、节操（夫死守志不再嫁之节）
entries.en: chastity; conjugal fidelity — the virtue of the widow who does not remarry

entries.zh: 节妇——守节不再嫁之妇
entries.en: chaste widow; a woman who does not remarry

entries.zh: 姿色——女子容貌姿色、美貌
entries.en: (a woman's) beauty, good looks
